You're helpless to resist as the beautiful bee girl

find the last fragments of your resistance slipping
away. Soon you mind is left a blank slate, waiting
to be written on.
The bee girl calmly leads you deeper into the hive.

your every thought and you begin to relax even more.

you reach a sparkling pool of golden honey and
she starts to speak once more.

to survive much longer.\.

find yourself striding into the deep honey, until
you're completely submerged within the golden
liquid.
MGFaceset7
Don't worry, I'll be back later when
you're all done, okay?
As the bee girl flies off you find yourself
drifting away into a deep and peaceful sleep.
Bee3
When you finally awaken you find your body has
been melded by the sweet honey and that your mind
is filled only with thoughts of your hive and your
sisters.
As you slowly climb out of the golden pool, new
feelings erupt from parts of your body that never
existed before.
The fragile wings upon your back begin to flutter
as you shake off the last remnants of the honey,
and your human mind. Your entire body tingles
as thoughts of your new purpose enter your mind.
